title: pilosella pseudosulphurea
intro: Pilosella pseudosulphurea, commonly known as yellow salsify, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its use in reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella pseudosulphurea include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help soothe skin irritations and fight off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are known for their medicinal properties and may contribute to its therapeutic effects.
